summary: Make cross-renderer localStorage writes observably committed before kit isolation audit reads

rules.detail: No runtime or policy rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Chromium's per-origin localStorage commits in the browser before a retained audit page's cached view updates; the isolation worker now re-reads a probe whose read raced a DOMStorage mutation acknowledgment, and the browser test awaits the same acknowledgment. No product behavior or protocol changes.

downtime.detail: No runtime deployment or migration changes.

recovery.detail: Test-harness and audit-read hardening only; residual storage detection semantics are unchanged.
